Kwame Mensah  
Email: kwame.mensah@advertiseX.com | Phone: +34 666 123 456 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/kwame-mensah | Location: Madrid, Spain  

A senior platform engineer with a decade of experience in adtech infrastructure, specializing in cloud-native systems, cost-effective scaling, and resilient operations. My career has been defined by architecting scalable solutions that balance technical rigor with business impact, particularly within small to mid-sized tech teams. I thrive in environments where innovation meets operational stability, and I’ve consistently delivered systems that support high-availability services while driving measurable efficiency gains.  

At AdvertiseX Technologies, I’ve evolved from leading platform architecture to shaping the organization’s technical strategy. My work has centered on optimizing AWS infrastructure to support the company’s rapid growth, designing CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment friction, and implementing monitoring frameworks that improved incident resolution times. Previously, at MediaSphere Solutions, I spearheaded a Kubernetes migration that increased cluster efficiency by 40% and reduced manual intervention in scaling workflows. Early in my career, at ClickAd Networks, I built foundational DevOps practices that later became a blueprint for team automation.  

**Projects**  
- **AdvertiseX Cloud Cost Optimization Initiative (2021–2023):** Redesigned AWS resource allocation strategies, introducing auto-scaling policies and reserved instance frameworks that reduced monthly cloud spend by €120,000 without compromising performance. Collaborated cross-functionally to align cost metrics with business KPIs, resulting in a 30% improvement in budget forecasting accuracy.  
- **Kubernetes Cluster Consolidation (2020):** Migrated three legacy platforms to a unified Kubernetes environment, reducing management overhead by 50% and improving deployment consistency across teams. Implemented custom dashboards for real-time resource tracking, enabling proactive capacity planning.  
- **Monitoring Overhaul (2019):** Redesigned the observability stack to integrate Prometheus, Grafana, and cloud-native logging, cutting mean time to detect (MTTD) critical issues from 2 hours to under 15 minutes. This shift also improved team collaboration by providing unified visibility into system health.  

**Technical Skills**  
AWS remains central to my work, where I’ve designed architectures that balance scalability with cost efficiency. I’ve mentored teams on best practices for EC2, S3, and Lambda integration, ensuring services meet SLA requirements while minimizing waste. My focus on cloud cost optimization has led to measurable savings across multiple projects, including a 25% reduction in redundant storage costs through automated lifecycle policies.  

Kubernetes has been a cornerstone of my platform engineering approach, particularly in environments requiring rapid scaling. I’ve managed fleets of clusters supporting millions of daily ad impressions, ensuring high availability through automated failover and resource prioritization. My work on CI/CD pipelines has streamlined deployment processes, reducing release cycles from weeks to hours while maintaining deployment reliability.  

Monitoring and alerting frameworks are integral to my operational philosophy. I’ve implemented systems that not only track metrics but also predict bottlenecks, enabling proactive interventions. These systems have significantly reduced unplanned downtime, with one notable instance cutting incident resolution time by 60% through structured alert triaging.
